evals.prompt: Using the approved avatar, recreate this creator's split-screen news short on a new robotics story from this month.
evals.expected_output: A BRIEF.md from the reference format, a sourced topic and 60-72 word script, a 1:1 talking-head take, official B-roll with provenance and usage basis, and a split-screen render with STT-timed captions and badges, reflected on the production canvas.
assertions: Every number in the script appears in topic.md with at least two sources.
B-roll of the real product is acquired from official sources with URL, time range, SHA-256 and usage basis, and is never generated.
Captions are timed from speech_to_text words of the generated take via stt_words.py.
The render is produced from a contiguous edl.json with render_short.py.
The showcase-html canvas is updated with the take and the render.

evals.prompt: Do two different options in parallel: one faithful split-screen, one dynamic remix, each on a different real tech story.
evals.expected_output: Shared avatar assets and BRIEF.md approved in the main thread, one sub-agent per option with exclusive ownership of options/<x>/, one paid submission per take registered by the main agent in the project task_ids.json, and two rendered shorts on the production canvas.
assertions: Each option agent writes only inside its own options/<x>/ folder.
Each take is submitted once, and the main agent records its job and task IDs in the project task_ids.json.
The remix option uses a 9:16 camera-beat take; the split-screen option may use 1:1.
Both renders appear on the showcase-html canvas, which is served locally and not published.
